title: GOLDEN HOUR: Romantic Walk BGM (original score)
description:
Two people, one evening walk by the sea, and a melody that keeps coming back like the waves. A soft female hum and a bamboo flute carry the hook over a gentle tabla groove, warm strings and a tumbi that smiles back.

For fans of romantic BGM, love walk scenes, humming melodies and feel-good South Indian film music. Headphones on.

Music: Golden Hour, an original score by ÆTHER. Composed for ÆTHER, made with AI.
